details:
Controller binding limits the number of gestures/expressions an avatar can have.
It would be nice if we're able to add multiple animation controllers/overrides that we can quickly switch between, rather than loading in an alternate version of an avatar.

As well as taking time, multiple avatars has other drawbacks such as; bandwidth, cache filling, the processing hit for others when a new avatar is loaded, larger avatar list, and creators managing/maintaining multiple versions of an avatar.

# Use Cases
* Quickly switching to a set that has animations for a different mood.
* Switching to a set that has no vocal/expression animations, so you can interact with things or use hand gestures, without your avatar making a noise or pulling a silly face.
* If we're able to always have the default animations as an option, it might make some public/world models more appealing, as a user can switch to the defaults if they like the model, but not the animations provided.  
* It would be great if switching (or re-selecting the current) animation set fixed your avatar if an animation gets stuck.

# Potential Request Duplication
This partly duplicates another request, but my request is only requesting one of their features, which I thought was a sufficient reduction of scope to warrant a separate request.
https://vrchat.canny.io/feature-requests/p/multiple-animation-avatar-advance-avatar-options
title: In-game switching animation sets
